open_points.subject: create_expense_from_recognition
open_points.text: - create_expense_from_recognition: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it creates and every current-time comparison it makes; the publication's `confirmed_at` is copied as confirmed, never replaced by it; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.other_text: def append_audit(repository: AuditRepository, intent: AuditIntent) -> AuditRecord
open_points.question: Must the single instant also determine the required audit record's occurred_at timestamp? If so, append_audit must accept that instant (or AuditIntent must carry it); otherwise the behavior note must explicitly exclude timestamps created by append_audit.
